# Download languages to use offline

Android phone & tabletiPhone & iPad

More

More

You can download languages onto your device. This lets you translate them without an internet connection.

After you’ve downloaded a language, you could be able to translate it by looking at it through your device's camera lens. [See languages that work with instant camera translations](https://support.google.com/translate/answer/6142483).

## Choose & download languages

1. Before you download languages, connect to Wi-Fi.
2. Open the Translate app ![Translate app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zbjy4lVco3DJT8GqHw3TXq74-q7utDszuEWMeKIpDcQTG-jL5v82cUTBy1wg=w16).
3. At the bottom, select the language you want to download.
4. Next to the language, tap Download ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/Xv_MeSheQLE6J9BLMqGbHnTNNxLUmILa3K4D2gfLbmyySjXzW3smBzecUdy6EP00I7w=w18).

   - If it’s not there, the language can’t be downloaded.
   - If it asks you to download the language file, tap **Download**.

**Tip:** In the Translate app, your saved languages show up as Downloaded ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/jpqh5kz_17k9ppEdam4C_65OOirxvrnMJ7vlqt36sw8O6VaiXcW6f6_f5DN9Yw=w18).

### Download languages without Wi-Fi

Since language files are small, when you’re not connected to Wi-Fi, you can download them with mobile data. If you don’t use Wi-Fi, it may affect your mobile carrier charges.

1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Translate app ![Translate app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zbjy4lVco3DJT8GqHw3TXq74-q7utDszuEWMeKIpDcQTG-jL5v82cUTBy1wg=w16).
2. Tap Menu ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/UYVGdnOY33gkFyAvmY4Xa1Se8-bLinBEnU35eQ3kMlBrgHWj9g3AU6O-ekxOdxqkERk=w36-h36)![and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/QbWcYKta5vh_4-OgUeFmK-JOB0YgLLoGh69P478nE6mKdfpWQniiBabjF7FVoCVXI0g=h36) Settings ![Settings](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/357M8Fx_lLhnrWQd9imNXnB9lDqgu0a0t-9d6xzF1aU82S4S-3FBi86iLFjvieQkbV4Z=w36-h36)![and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/QbWcYKta5vh_4-OgUeFmK-JOB0YgLLoGh69P478nE6mKdfpWQniiBabjF7FVoCVXI0g=h36)**Data usage**.
3. Tap **Downloaded languages**.

   - **To always confirm before you download without Wi-Fi:** Tap **Ask before downloading**.
   - **To always use mobile data when you can't use Wi-Fi:** Tap **Use Wi-Fi or mobile network**.

## Update or remove languages

1. Connect to Wi-Fi.
2. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Translate app ![Translate app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zbjy4lVco3DJT8GqHw3TXq74-q7utDszuEWMeKIpDcQTG-jL5v82cUTBy1wg=w16).
3. Tap Menu ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/UYVGdnOY33gkFyAvmY4Xa1Se8-bLinBEnU35eQ3kMlBrgHWj9g3AU6O-ekxOdxqkERk=w36-h36)![and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/QbWcYKta5vh_4-OgUeFmK-JOB0YgLLoGh69P478nE6mKdfpWQniiBabjF7FVoCVXI0g=h36) Downloaded languages ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/ETm4UEMaQfHDOeP8aYuItPbd-4Q4hBq9kc2UZd2gAAEdYJm1jkYCSkV2-_p4K6mzMbkz=w36-h36).
4. You’ll get a list of available languages.
   - **To upgrade a language to a higher-quality language pack:** Next to the language, tap **Upgrade**.
   - **To update a language on your device:** Next to the language, tap **Update**.
   - **To delete a language from your device:** Tap Remove ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/omPP8k3T58rWn37iYHeqxPBOgiN6-8ILrPob4vuEdXX62w2a6efMb6114n-qQa06570=w36-h36). When asked if you want to remove the downloaded package, tap **Remove**.

# How can I get text to speech translations in offline mode?

I've downloaded the languages (french and arabic) to use them without needing internet, but I can only use the text to speech option with spanish (native language), so I was wondering if there is any option to download voice packages or something or that's managed by the phone.

Offline Speech output has never been supported directly by the Google Translate app. The Translate app itself does not download the data for Text To Speech (TTS) output.

I say "directly" because depending on your phone -- the text to speech system on your phone \*may\* work offline, depending on if it is Samsung TTS, Google/Pixel TTS, Motorola TTS, etc. When online, the Translate app requests TTS audio from Google servers. When offline, we fall back to the TTS as available on your particular phone, and whether the Android OS (not Google's) TTS service reports it can speak for a given language when offline. Depending on your phone's TTS setup (Samsung, Pixel, OnePlus, etc) -- TTS may work offline if your phone is so configured.

There is no ability for the Translate app to communicate or coordinate with each phone's TTS -- so offline TTS is hit-or-miss at this point. If you are able to download TTS offline in your phone's settings, then this may work, but Translate is unable to link you there or perform this configuration for you.

It's possible to include Google TTS with Translate, but the team is not in a position to develop such a feature at this time.

Hi,

Here are some of the troubleshooting steps to fix this kind of issues.

﻿ 1\. Ensure the your language pack is fully downloaded:

\- Go to the Google Translate app on your device.

\- Tap on the "Settings" icon (gear icon).

\- Select "Offline translation."

\- Check if the your language pack is listed as "Available for offline use" and indicates a downloaded size.

\- If it's not downloaded, tap "Download" next to the your language.

2\. Confirm Your Offline Mode:

\- Ensure your device is in Airplane Mode or completely disconnected from the internet.

\- Turn off Wi-Fi and cellular data connections.

3\. Restart the Google Translate App:

\- Close the Google Translate app completely.

\- Relaunch the app and check if it now works offline.

4\. Check App Permissions:

\- Make sure the Google Translate app has the necessary permissions, such as storage access and internet access, enabled.

\- Go to your device's "Settings" > "Apps" or "Application Manager."

\- Find the Google Translate app and select "Permissions."

\- Enable all the necessary permissions, including storage and internet access.

5\. Reinstall the Google Translate App:

\- If the issue persists, try reinstalling the Google Translate app.

\- Uninstall the app from your device.

\- Restart your device.

\- Download and reinstall the Google Translate app from the App Store or Google Play Store.

Thanks,

# Translate images

You can use your phone’s camera to translate text in the Translate app ![Translate app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zbjy4lVco3DJT8GqHw3TXq74-q7utDszuEWMeKIpDcQTG-jL5v82cUTBy1wg=w16). For example, you can translate signs or handwritten notes.

Android phone & tabletComputeriPhone & iPad

More

More

## Translate text in images

In the Translate app, you can translate text from images on your phone. With some devices, you can also translate text you find through your camera.

**Important:** The translation accuracy depends on the clarity of the text. Translation of small, unclear, or stylized text may not be accurate.

To translate text with your camera:

1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Translate app ![Translate app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zbjy4lVco3DJT8GqHw3TXq74-q7utDszuEWMeKIpDcQTG-jL5v82cUTBy1wg=w16).
2. Choose the languages you want to translate to and from.
   - **From:** Choose a language or tap Detect language![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/9EziRpr5AVJih1KMSb_FlHzD8ey8zNTj7xDrZSvb90-BkXvrCAan16oPBe6LaH2SjQ=w36-h36).
   - **To:** Select the language you want the translation in.
3. On the app home screen, tap Camera ![Camera](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/eA4bJzXg6KSxOFPcXVPgd0v6oiUuoM-q_HMCy63UYWydXOJWj3esWh610iTda2DHe_sZ=w36-h36).

   - **To translate text from an image you’ve already captured:** tap All Images ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-SM-uGtM-6ARdDu5mnlwVhLM58xRsS9mCTT2TOBd1i0xE1F_zbn-f1UWEZlJrkFn6Q=h36).
   - **To translate what you find through your camera:**
     1. Point your camera at the text you want to translate.
     2. Tap Shutter Button ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/Q7MrCwEJGYM78osDDQArvPKfH_yY7FZkRwsMklXMdNdXkERiSW2NSk7eACF1HzEQnhc=w36-h36).

**Tip:** To freeze the translated text in camera view, tap Shutter ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/Q7MrCwEJGYM78osDDQArvPKfH_yY7FZkRwsMklXMdNdXkERiSW2NSk7eACF1HzEQnhc=w36-h36).

## Translate part of text

You can select sections of an image to translate.

1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Translate app ![Translate app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zbjy4lVco3DJT8GqHw3TXq74-q7utDszuEWMeKIpDcQTG-jL5v82cUTBy1wg=w16).
2. Choose the languages you want to translate to and from.
   - **From:** Choose a language or tap Detect language![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/9EziRpr5AVJih1KMSb_FlHzD8ey8zNTj7xDrZSvb90-BkXvrCAan16oPBe6LaH2SjQ=w36-h36).
   - **To:** Select the language you want the translation in.
3. Tap Camera ![Camera](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/eA4bJzXg6KSxOFPcXVPgd0v6oiUuoM-q_HMCy63UYWydXOJWj3esWh610iTda2DHe_sZ=w36-h36)  and use the Shutter Button ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/Q7MrCwEJGYM78osDDQArvPKfH_yY7FZkRwsMklXMdNdXkERiSW2NSk7eACF1HzEQnhc=w36-h36).
4. To view Translate options, tap Expand ![keyboard arrow down](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/KDni8Qrn5dQrWXoHtRdPTOwStSiIxXvSoaoRzibCf6OkCeM61jgiP5o-9D7IKdrN-wE=w36-h36).

   - Toggle to turn on **S** **how original text**, below the language picker.
5. Select text
   - Tap any word to select it, then drag the selection anchors to adjust the selected text. The translated text will show up in the card.
   - If you turn on **Show original text** it will show the captured text untranslated.

**Tip:** If the text is too long to view in the card, drag the card up.

## Work with translated text

Once the text in an image is translated, you can do things like copy the text, have it read aloud, or send it to Translate Home for more information.

1. Select the part of the text you want to take action on.
2. At the bottom, choose an option from the carousel:
   - **Copy text:** To copy the text, select the text you’d like to copy and tap Copy text ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/elhuqfze84oZ2L3WThpIm-VQLkd_Te6JuuKgiBXdT0Zo9rxgkmxStzKPsw0OeCYUnAc=w36-h36).
   - **Listen:** To have Translate read your translated text, tapListen![Listen](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/oeRiTYsw2CSePmznbylybMkS3bGYa2KuQspmtCqm50ReX55KtToZx-SOH-V602BRog=w24).
   - **Send to Translate Home**: To get more information, tap Send to Translate Home ![Translate](https://storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/SNP_6071E8EE8B6E49B76B18CF55949C1C8CAE27_3540814_en_v0).
   - **Search**: To search translated text on Google, tap  Search ![Google app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/4zRHGz2iRIlBsHcNuZCxyQK2n_6cj3n7A2lgsptGmqh-rKJ_waLQqhQG021_3oqIFw=h48).

## Use offline camera translations

To use camera translations offline, download the languages that you want to translate.

1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Translate app ![Translate app](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zbjy4lVco3DJT8GqHw3TXq74-q7utDszuEWMeKIpDcQTG-jL5v82cUTBy1wg=w16).
2. Tap the Camera ![Camera](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/eA4bJzXg6KSxOFPcXVPgd0v6oiUuoM-q_HMCy63UYWydXOJWj3esWh610iTda2DHe_sZ=w36-h36).
3. Tap the Language picker.
4. Download the language(s) you’d like your translation in.

After the download is complete, camera translations will work for the downloaded language(s) even when you're disconnected from the internet.

## Get the best results

To get the best translation results for your images:

1. Check that the “Translate from” and “Translate to” languages are correct.
2. Use a strong network connection.
3. In low light, tap Camera Flash ![Camera flash](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/Oh4FCOhx4bJeu3X5LU00VSCXSuRnSGDsg4RTSsnDJ_yUumVLZO1Yfj2KnNFq7wmhzZk=w18).
4. Use clear and commonly used fonts for best results.

## Send feedback

To send feedback, tap **Enter Text**![and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36) Menu ![Menu icon](https://lh3.ggpht.com/tujBvt0bXQbS_x4oNPj-00cM_qh-4IcZUlmlBNrZZ1qYRQF1fBBIfe1rSIyOZC30gcE=w36-h36)![and then](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36) Send feedback ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/0JDsDhdGR1UmRQy68g7KVYHTbNO4QqUtQr33lXlrDns-SHa_9s8a7z9dt2CZvWAsKpI=h36).
